messages:
Evan (PM): Flagged from customer call: when toggling Org ↔ Project the spending timeline reflows and the "Download invoices" CTA drops below the fold on medium screens. They want invoice actions persistent without extra scrolling. Screenshot: https://files.internal/redwood/cta-drop-medium.png

Priya (Designer): I sketched two options in Figma:
1) Persistent header bar inside Usage panel: left side scope + primary invoice CTAs, right side chart controls.
2) Inline compact legend (top-3 tokens) with a single "+more" pill; invoice CTAs remain sticky at panel-top when width < 960px.
Link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/persistent-invoice-cta

Jon (Frontend): Sticky header works but watch z-index with global nav. If we stick inside the panel we can avoid global overlaps. For keyboard: keep CTAs first in DOM and visually pin the header. I can prototype in Storybook.

Kai (Data): Note: top-3 token heuristic should default to "by spend USD". For accuracy we should include a tooltip on each chip: show exact token_id and absolute cost (not just percent). We'll return token_id in the payload.

Rosa (Billing): Important: only billing_admins should see "Download invoices". Also ensure the CSV contains project_id and token_type columns — we had a support case when project_id was missing. Please keep CSV header stable.

Priya (Designer): Accessibility notes in the figma comments:
- ARIA: header region gets role="region" and aria-label="Billing controls"
- Ensure pinned CTA has visible focus ring and is first tabbable control
- For the "+more" pill use aria-expanded and aria-controls to reveal the full list in a modal/panel

Jon (Frontend): Plan:
- Implement feature flag `billingPersistentHeader`
- Make header sticky within panel, keep DOM order with CTAs first
- Dropdown/panel for full legend with focus trap & Escape to close
- Keyboard shortcut: press "b" to focus billing CTAs while panel focused (I'll check conflicts).
ETA: draft PR early next week.

Kai (Data): Backend support: add `token_id` and `scope` fields to the legend API. Also add `legend_order` meta (e.g., "project-first") so front-end can render deterministically and exports preserve order. I'll add to the API spec.

Rosa (Billing): CSV schema reminder: include headers token_label, token_id, scope, project_id, cost_usd, tokens_count. Also include a header comment line `# legend_order: project-first` when applicable.

Evan (PM): Summary of action items: @Priya update Figma with sticky-inside-panel + compact legend variants; @Jon prototype sticky header and keyboard flow + feature flag; @Kai update API to include token_id/scope/legend_order; @Rosa confirm CSV header and RBAC rendering. Follow-up sync Thu 11:00am PT. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
